description: Na₃In₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.74 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra, corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 65°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.63 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 65°. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.28 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-66°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one In, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent In and one P atom.
